name: Adobe for creativity
description:
Adobe for creativity brings Photoshop, Lightroom, Illustrator, Firefly, Premiere, Express, InDesign, and Stock capabilities directly into Claude. Create, edit, and design with natural language, without switching apps. Edit multiple photos, create assets, and refine video for polished results. Sign in with your Adobe account for higher usage limits and saved work across sessions.
Key capabilities:
• Edit and transform images: Adjust color and lighting, remove/blur backgrounds, and expand or crop images.
• Create and animate assets: Start from a template, trim video, and license stock.
• Search, organize, and summarize: Find assets, summarize content, and manage files.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Adobe for creativity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Adobe for creativity to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://adobe-creativity.adobe.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Adobe for creativity MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe for creativity lists 67 MCP tools, including adobe_mandatory_init, animate_design, asset_add_file, asset_copy_assets, asset_create_folders, asset_finalize_file_upload, asset_get_brand, asset_get_brand_color_themes, asset_get_brand_colors, asset_get_brand_fonts, asset_get_brand_guidelines, and asset_get_brand_logos.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Adobe for creativity?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Adobe for creativity in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.

_published_faq.name: Does Adobe for creativity MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe for creativity requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Adobe for creativity is developed by Adobe Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
